reason: The existing [ticket_url] Notify shortcode already links each attendee to the Edit Ticket page that shows their check-in QR code; what remains is whether to add more.
question: Is pointing organizers to [ticket_url] enough, or should Notify get a [checkin_url] alias and/or an embedded [qr_code] image (which would need a hosted image, since Notify mail is plain text by default and most mail clients drop inline SVG)?
